text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.8 solar radii and 3.09 solar masses (FLAME) and 10,302 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Lambda Cancri
quotes.card: Lambda Cancri is a blue-white-hued spectroscopic binary star in the zodiac constellation of Cancer.
quotes.introduction: Its name is a Bayer designation that is Latinized from λ Cancri, and abbreviated Lambda Cnc or λ Cnc.
